defect: a 40-hex coordinate quoted inside a published receipt was hand-typed from a console line and was the bare sha1 of the file's bytes, not a git blob id, so it resolves nowhere
wrong_because: git's blob id is sha1 over 'blob <len>' + NUL + bytes; the console line that was transcribed printed the publisher's raw sha1 of the content instead
rule_fitted_after: the receipt now takes that field from published_blob(), which reads the publisher's own rows, so no 40-hex in the block or the receipt is typed by hand
